item.title: Bryan Norcross: Tropical depression is struggling but Bertha is still forecast to develop in the Northern Gulf
item.description: Tropical Depression Two has a broad circulation with clusters of heavy thunderstorms, but it's infused with dry air. The overall environment is less conducive to organizing and strengthening today, but the moderately hostile upper winds still might abate enough for the system to spin up into Tropical Storm Bertha.
